page_title: IPS 1-2 BOU | Ipswich v Bournemouth 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.
90+5' 1 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) keeps his cool and scores.
90+2' Here is a change. Omari Hutchinson is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Wes Burns (Ipswich).
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) replaces Jack Taylor.
90' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to David Brooks (Bournemouth), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Enes Unal (Bournemouth) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
87' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
87' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
86' Today's match ends for Ryan Christie who will be replaced by James Hill (Bournemouth).
86' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) trips an opposition player and Michael Salisbury signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Ipswich.
83' The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.

83' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
81' Kieran McKenna decides to make a substitution. Liam Delap will be replaced by Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich).
80' Substitution. Jack Clarke (Ipswich) in, Sammie Szmodics out.
80' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.

79' That didn't go as planned! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Arijanet Muric, who easily kept it out. Now Bournemouth have a corner.
74' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Evanilson is replaced by Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Brooks (Bournemouth) is coming onto the pitch as Marcus Tavernier cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
71' Great touch by Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
71' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
69' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes a short corner kick.
67' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
67' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) launches a cross from the corner, but Arijanet Muric is alert to thwart the effort.
65' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jack Taylor (Ipswich). Michael Salisbury saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Bournemouth have a free kick.
63' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replacing Adam Smith.
63' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Justin Kluivert.
60' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) picks up an injury.
54' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
54' Leif Davis (Ipswich) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Corner kick. Ipswich will have an opportunity.
52' What a beautiful long-range strike by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
49' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a smart save to deny him.
44' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth). A free kick is awarded to Ipswich.

42' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Ipswich will have a goal kick.
42' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
40' The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

38' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Bournemouth force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
36' The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
36' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
35' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Arijanet Muric rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
33' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
31' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Kepa Arrizabalaga expertly pushes away.
30' Referee Michael Salisbury halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Andoni Iraola, then shows him a yellow.
29' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
29' Referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
29' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
28' POST! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
27' Celebrations are cut short for Cameron Burgess (Ipswich) as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
27' Cameron Burgess (Ipswich) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Michael Salisbury immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
26' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ipswich.
25' Corner kick. Leif Davis (Ipswich) is ready to send the ball into the box.
23' The foul by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) was seen by Michael Salisbury who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. It's a free kick to Ipswich, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Cameron Burgess slips it to Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) on the edge of the box and he lashes the ball low into the middle of the net. The score is 1:0.

20' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.

19' Jack Taylor (Ipswich) has a big opportunity to score! He climbs highest deep inside the penalty box and strikes a powerful header towards the goal. Next time he should aim better as his effort flies narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
18' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
16' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.
15' Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee blows his whistle, Ipswich are awarded a corner kick.
15' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' Bournemouth failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Michael Salisbury shows the yellow card to Liam Delap (Ipswich) for a heavy challenge.
12' Evanilson (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
9' Liam Delap (Ipswich) makes a strong challenge and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul. Bournemouth are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

8' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
7' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
3' The ball is behind the sideline. Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) takes a throw-in.
1' The players are on the pitch and Ipswich will have the kick-off.
1' The first half has just begun.
Michael Salisbury is the one to supervise the game today.
